newsitem.title: USA: Access, Block Drug canker drug gets FDA ok.
newsitem.headline: Access, Block Drug canker drug gets FDA ok.

text.p: Access Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has given marketing approval for Aphthasol.
Aphthasol is a prescription treatment for canker sores Access developed jointly with Block Drug Co.
ACCESS sold its rights for Aphthasol to Block Drug in 1995.
The company said besides an up front payment it received, it will get royalty payments on all product sales in excess of $25 million.
Block Drug Co shares were off 3/4 Thursday afternoon at 46-1/2. Access shares were unchanged at 1-1/32.
